text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"Blend contamination is the strongest non-astrophysical explanation: 350 of 564 trigger points are flagged BLEND_SUSPECT, and the listed event points with negative offsets (E-041, E-045, E-046, E-047, E-049, E-051, E-053, E-054) carry that tag, so the dip may come from a neighbouring source on the plate rather than the star.","evidence_ids":["E-058","E-041","E-045","E-046","E-047","E-049","E-051","E-053","E-054"]},{"text":"Shape and plate-edge defects touch a sizeable share of the points that define the event: 165 of 564 points are SHAPE_OUTLIER and 35 are PLATE_EDGE, and several of the listed points carry these tags, including E-044 and E-048 at plate edges and E-047, E-049, E-051, E-053 as shape outliers.","evidence_ids":["E-060","E-061","E-044","E-048","E-047","E-049","E-051","E-053"]},{"text":"Emulsion response is a plausible artifact route: 35 of 564 points are flagged emulsion_non_blue, and the listed point E-052 at 1946.965 carries the NON_BLUE tag with a positive offset of 0.619, so a colour-dependent emulsion response could shift a subset of magnitudes.","evidence_ids":["E-056","E-052"]},{"text":"The event sits in the 1930 to 1940 region where the plate-to-plate scatter is largest and the series zero points disagree: the 1930s decade has scatter 0.453 and median offset 0.031, the 1940s has scatter 0.417, while the zero points of series such as rh (-0.125) and rl (-0.194) differ from mc (0.539) and i (0.525), so a seam between plate series could produce apparent step changes.","evidence_ids":["E-009","E-010","E-038","E-039","E-033","E-028"]},{"text":"The packet cannot exclude an artifact because only 30 of 564 trigger points are shown and the rest were thinned to fit the budget, so the evidence that the dip persists across plates and series is incomplete; the checks that passed (source_merged, deep_limit_suspect, no_plate_offset, detrended) do not establish that the event is real, and the event remains a candidate, not a discovery.","evidence_ids":["E-055","E-059","E-062","E-064","E-066","E-002"]}]}
